title: Kumul Dataco Undersea Fibre Optic Cable Landing Stations
summary: Design and supervision of cable landing stations for the Huawei-built undersea fibre optic network, plus satellite and VSAT platforms in five provinces.
location: Kokopo, Kavieng, Mt Hagen, Wabag and Mendi
body:
RNL designed and supervised civil and structural works for the cable landing stations of the undersea fibre optic cable network.

## Scope

- Cable landing station structures, including bridging structures
- Pits, manholes and monitoring facilities
- Satellite and VSAT platforms at Kokopo, Kavieng, Mt Hagen, Wabag and Mendi
